# Awesome CTO

> — Hello, my name is Dima and I'm a CTO
>
> — (chorus) Welcome, Dima


A curated and **opinionated** list of resources for [Chief Technology Officers and VP R&D](https://kuchin.github.io/awesome-cto/), with the emphasis on startups and hyper-growth companies.

📢 [Subscribe to get updates](https://awesomecto.substack.com/)


## Contents

 * [CTO Position](#cto-position)
 * [Hiring](#hiring)
 * [People management](#people-management)
 * [Career growth](#career-growth)
 * [Project management](#project-management)
 * [Handbooks](#handbooks)
 * [Development process](#development-process)
 * [Architecture](#architecture)
 * [Technologies](#technologies)
 * [Data](#data)
 * [Startups](#startups)
 * [Due Diligence](#due-diligence)
 * [Money / Finance](#money--finance)
 * [Related stuff](#related-stuff)
 * [Product](#product)
 * [Marketing](#marketing)
 * [Books](#books)
 * [More links](#more-links)


## CTO Position

 * [The Different CTO Roles](https://www.allthingsdistributed.com/2007/07/the_different_cto_roles.html) - Werner Vogels *(Amazon CTO)*

aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated list of resources for Chief Technology Officers and engineering leaders.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Awesome CTO is a comprehensive, curated repository of resources specifically tailored for Chief Technology Officers, VP of Engineering, and other technical leaders. It focuses heavily on the challenges faced by technical leaders in startups and hyper-growth companies. The repository categorizes content into essential areas such as hiring, people management, architecture, decision-making, and project management. It provides an opinionated selection of articles, books, and tools to help leaders navigate both the technical and human aspects of running an engineering organization. By aggregating high-quality advice, it serves as a central reference point for continuous learning in engineering leadership.
keyFeatures: Categorized resources: Organizes content into clear categories like hiring, architecture, and people management for easy navigation.
Opinionated selection: Curates resources based on quality and relevance rather than attempting to list every available link.
Startup focus: Prioritizes advice and resources that are particularly relevant to the fast-paced environment of startups and hyper-growth companies.
Comprehensive scope: Covers a wide range of topics from technical architecture to due diligence and marketing.
Continuous updates: Maintained actively with new resources and insights relevant to modern engineering leadership.
Handbook links: Provides access to public engineering handbooks from successful tech companies as reference material.

useCases.title: New CTO onboarding
useCases.description: Newly appointed technical leaders use it as a foundational reading list to understand the breadth of their new responsibilities.

useCases.title: Engineering management reference
useCases.description: Engineering managers consult the repository for best practices on hiring, 1-on-1s, and career growth for their teams.

useCases.title: Architecture decision making
useCases.description: Technical leaders reference the architecture section when evaluating high-level technical strategies for scaling their platforms.

useCases.title: Due diligence preparation
useCases.description: Founders and CTOs use the due diligence resources to prepare their engineering organization for technical audits by investors.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This resource is primarily for current and aspiring Chief Technology Officers, VPs of Engineering, and Engineering Managers. It is especially valuable for those working in startups or fast-growing technology companies.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Read the README.md on the GitHub repository to browse the categorized resources.
